units: <cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 4:8">Deut. R. s. 4</cite> <he>עשה שם ר״ל פ׳ וכ׳</he> (some ed. <cite ref="Q01353"><he>פסקא</he></cite>) Resh Laḳish arranged there a subscription, and he (Abin) gave as much as the entire assembly.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 13:16">Num. R. s. 13</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 19:8-10">Ps. XIX, 8-10</cite>) [read:] <he>שלשה פסוקים … והן מן שתים שתים פִּסְקוֹת וכל פ׳ ופ׳ מן וכ׳</he> three verses … each consisting of two hemistichs, and each hemistich containing five words.—Pl. <cite ref="Q01357"><he>פִּסְקוֹת</he></cite>.
